snippet.title: Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Release Date Announcement Trailer for Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite, a cooperative deck-building game developed by Bandit Island Games. Players will team up with heroes and villains alike to engage in card-based battles to succeed in Eternia's Trials. Collect powerful cards, unleash devastating abilities, and claim victory at all costs. Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite is launching on June 5 for Amazon Luna.
